path.aria-label: ZRAM diagnostic v10 · sequential phases · configured thresholds and deadlines
Check active ZRAM, backing partition, pressure service, compressed writeback and available memory.
Reserve logical swap and backing capacity; start the bounded cold worker.
Stop hot worker. Cool down 35 s.
Flip, restore and discard each page.
Stop transient test units first; report phase outcomes, integrity, compression and tuning history.
Save timestamped text and CSV logs. Exit 0 only when all three phases pass and cleanup succeeds.
Readback watchdog: 300 s without verified progress. Fatal failures stop the sequence; inconclusive phases may continue.
The cards show execution order, not measured durations. No test-run values are included.
